title: A not-yet item past its posting window is settled by a matching amount at any later date (decision AA14)
story: Set up Tue 22 Jun 2027 at 09:00. The bank holds 200,000. The insurance of 30,000 and the phone of 5,000 were both due Tue 8 Jun; both posting windows ended Wed 9 Jun, but the person says neither has gone out, so the opening saves both in `not_yet` (decision Z2: still expected). Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier) starts the period; the person ticks it on Fri 25 Jun. A bank statement read on Thu 1 Jul at 09:00 holds two lines dated Wed 30 Jun: 30,000 out (the insurance's amount, three weeks after its window, and six working days before the next insurance of Thu 8 Jul, so too early for that one) and 4,800 out (not the phone's amount). Every amount is made up.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 200,000 (opening) + 250,000 (pay, ticked Fri 25 Jun) - 30,000 (statement line Wed 30 Jun) - 4,800 (statement line Wed 30 Jun) = 415,200

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 415,200 (Bank today) - 5,000 (Phone 8 Jun, not gone out at setup and not matched by the 4,800 line: still expected) - 30,000 (Insurance 8 Jul) - 5,000 (Phone 8 Jul) = 375,200
asks.note: AA14: the 30,000 line settles the insurance of 8 Jun though it is three weeks past its window, so that insurance is not taken off again. Before AA14 the line stayed unmatched and the insurance was still expected: 30,000 less.

asks.question: not_seen_yet
asks.note: The phone of 8 Jun is still expected, not "not seen yet" [Z2]; the insurance of 8 Jun is seen [AA14].
